record.bible_text: And the men<WH0376> of Ephraim<WH0669> gathered themselves together<WH06817><WTH8735>, and went<WH05674><WTH8799> northward<WH06828>, and said<WH0559><WTH8799> unto Jephthah<WH03316>, Wherefore passedst thou over<WH05674><WTH8804> to fight<WH03898><WTH8736> against the children<WH01121> of Ammon<WH05983>, and didst not call<WH07121><WTH8804> us to go<WH03212><WTH8800> with thee? we will burn<WH08313><WTH8799> thine house<WH01004> upon thee with fire<WH0784>. <RF>gathered...: Heb. were called<Rf>
